text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon has decided to enter the Satsuki Sho. However, the path ahead is anything but smooth…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: W-well, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her aptitude makes for a big hurdle. As soon as she steps onto turf, her performance drops significantly.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Sigh… No good, huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I can tell something's off when I'm running. Like I just can't go all out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There isn't much time left before the Satsuki Sho. We either keep at it and hope for a miracle, or…
choice_data_list: We need to change things up, big time.
We need to change things up, big time.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: A big change…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: What about… Yeah! I think I might have juuust the thing! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …Whoa, whoa, whoooa! ♪ Yay!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Come on, Suzuka! You too, Trainer! Don't give me that blank expression. All together now… Yay! ☆

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Uh… Yay?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but… what's all this about again, Smart Falcon?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I told you to call me Falco! ☆ Don't be so uptight, Suzuka! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka has already achieved great success on turf. Her dynamic and powerful runaway style captivates everyone who sees it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon's bright idea seems to involve her somehow, but it's still unclear how this is helping…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um… I thought you wanted me to give you some pointers about running on turf…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's right! ☆ Thank you so much for agreeing to help. ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I love the way you run, Suzuka. That's why I want you to teach me!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm happy you feel that way, but… why are we at karaoke?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Before we run, I want to get some pointers on singing from you too. Ehe! ☆

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! It's not like I'm good at sin—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Y-you too?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right, let's go! L-O-V-E! I love Suzuka! ☆

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, after we spend some time learning (?) singing from Silence Suzuka…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff… I can't believe you made me sing six songs in a row…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haha, thanks for singing for us! ♪ You've got me sooo emotional! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's why I…

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Isn't that Silence Suzuka?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: That's her! It's Suzuka! Oh my gosh!

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text: Suzuka, in the flesh! Wow, she's even prettier in real life!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before we know it…

text_block_list.name: Suzuka Fan A
text_block_list.text: I saw your last race! You were amazing, as usual!

text_block_list.name: Suzuka Fan B
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to watch your next race! And, um… It's still cold, so make sure you stay warm!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh… Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wow, she's completely surrounded. Suzuka sure is popular.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …But, it's easy to understand why. Suzuka runs beautifully, and she sings beautifully.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: She's got me starstruck. I just love her!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I bet everyone feels energized just looking at her.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I wanna be like that too…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka is likely close to what Smart Falcon has in mind when she imagines a top Umadol.
choice_data_list: You've got what it takes, Falco.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks! I think so too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But I can't just stand on the sidelines dreaming!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I've got to make it happen with my own two legs!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hi, Suzuka fans! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm the Umadol everyone's talking about, Falco! And I'm gonna be running in the Satsuki Sho! ♪

text_block_list.name: Suzuka Fan A
text_block_list.text: "Falco"? I don't think I've heard of you…

text_block_list.name: Suzuka Fan B
text_block_list.text: But if you're running in the Satsuki Sho, you must be pretty good… I guess.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Weeell, why don't you find out with your own two eyes? ☆ See you at the racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm always performing on the street too, so drop by anytime! ♪

text_block_list.name: Suzuka Fan C
text_block_list.text: Well, she seems interesting. Maybe I'll look into her…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. She's really something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, Silence Suzuka gives Smart Falcon some running pointers back at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wow! She's so amazing. I'm gonna be just like her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inspired by Silence Suzuka's singing and running, Smart Falcon looks to the Satsuki Sho with a fresh spirit.
